methodology: Walk-forward: expanding window. For each test sample, models re-trained on ALL data before that point. No data leakage.
comparison_note: Walk-forward results are MORE ACCURATE than simplified backtesting (which used latest prediction for all test rows).

ml_integrity.target_construction: per-stock groupby(symbol).shift(-h) via add_forward_returns; no .fillna(0); immature rows left NaN
ml_integrity.test_partition: date-based chronological_split test partition (NOT global row split=int(len*0.8)) — all rows on a given test date belong to the test partition
ml_integrity.per_sample_training: per-sample train_data = df[df['date']<sample['date']] (strict chronological, no look-ahead)
ml_integrity.per_horizon_drop: per-sample, per-horizon dropna(subset=[hz_col]) — preserves shorter-horizon rows whose longest-horizon target is immature
ml_integrity.realized_outcomes: actual_return uses FUTURE close prices in the test partition (strictly AFTER the decision date) — no look-ahead leakage in the realized-outcome computation
ml_integrity.walk_forward_methodology: TRUE walk-forward: each test sample's models are re-fit on all data strictly before the sample's decision date. This is distinct from the simplified backtest in train_all_with_backtesting.py (Pattern #10 — latest signal applied to all test rows).
